author: igv4321
body:
Bug fix for using the Hcal pulse shapes from the database.

Normal matrix tests were run. In addition, private tests were done as described in #51631.

This PR is a backport of #51631 (meant for 17_0_X). Developed for potential Run 3 rereco scenarios.
title: A bug fix for the use of Hcal pulse shapes from CMS database
